description: Source code for a generic stackwalker implementation in the Google Breakpad project, including class definitions, methods for walking call stacks, and CPU-specific stackwalker factory method.

classes.name: Stackwalker
classes.description: A class providing stack walking functionality for different CPU architectures, including methods for walking call stacks, validating instruction addresses, and creating CPU-specific stackwalkers.

classes.name: StackFrame
classes.description: Represents a single frame in a call stack, including instruction address, module info, and trust level.

methods.name: Stackwalker::Walk
methods.description: Performs a stack walk, populating the provided CallStack object with frames, resolving source line info, and handling modules with or without symbols.

methods.name: Stackwalker::StackwalkerForCPU
methods.description: Factory method that creates a CPU-specific Stackwalker instance based on the context's CPU type.

methods.name: Stackwalker::InstructionAddressSeemsValid
methods.description: Checks if a given instruction address appears valid within the loaded modules and symbolization context.
